scripts.build: bun run build:rules-wasm && bun run build:nuxt
scripts.build:rules-wasm: cd ../.. && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p apps/web/worker/wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/fewfc.wasm apps/web/worker/wasm/fewfc.wasm
scripts.cf:dev: APP_ENV=development bun run build && wrangler dev --env=""
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: bun run validate:deploy staging && APP_ENV=staging bun run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.cf:deploy:production: bun run validate:deploy production && APP_ENV=production bun run build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.test:e2e:server: APP_ENV=development bun run build && node node_modules/.bin/wrangler d1 migrations apply fewfc-auth --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && node node_modules/.bin/wrangler dev --env="" --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --port 8787
